item.description:
🚨 Boletim de Cyber Segurança - Técnica
Visão geral:
• 0 com severidade Crítica
• 10 com severidade Alta
• 15 novas CVEs
• 5 novos advisories/exploits

────────────────────────────────────
Infraestrutura - Docker / ESX / Elastic / Grafana / Nginx / VMware / Zabbix

🚨 CVE-2026-49951 - Elastic
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Elastic
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 6.3
Resumo:
RAGFlow before 0.27.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers to force the server to issue requests to arbitrary internal or external endpoints by supplying an unvalidated base_url to the POST /v1/llm/set_api_key endpoint handled by set_api_key() in api/apps/llm_app.py. Attackers can exploit this flaw to probe shared-network services such as MySQL, Elasticsearch, Redis...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-49951
 
🚨 CVE-2026-103932 - Nginx
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Nginx
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 5.8
Resumo:
ModSecurity is an open source, cross platform web application firewall (WAF) engine for Apache, IIS and Nginx. From 3.0.5 until 3.0.17, the PCRE2 implementation of @rxGlobal in src/utils/regex.cc converts pcre2_match match-limit errors into an ordinary no-match result instead of propagating a non-OK RegexResult. When attacker-controlled input exhausts SecPcreMatchLimit, rules that rely on MSC_PCRE_LIMITS_EXCEEDED or...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-103932
 
🚨 CVE-2026-74756 - Docker
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Docker
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
Some docker-compose shipped by the project exposes by default Webadmin REST API publically without proper authentication setup. Version 3.9.1 onward sets a random credential by default on unprotected webadmin endpoints to prevent this while retain convenience.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-74756
 
📰 Scaling cyber protection for US critical infrastructure: How Elastic supports the Community Cyber Resilience Foundation
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Elastic
Fonte: https://www.elastic.co/blog/feed
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
Elastic powers critical cybersecurity capabilities within the Dragos Platform, helping the new Community Cyber Resilience Foundation protect under-resourced US water, electric, and natural gas utilities from cyber threats.
Link: https://www.elastic.co/blog/how-elastic-supports-the-community-cyber-resilience-foundation

Segurança - Acronis / Axur / Check Point / Harmony SASE / Qualys / SentinelOne

🚨 SonicWall Patches Exploited SonicOS Vulnerability That Weakens VPN Logins
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Check Point
Fonte: SecurityWeek
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
CVE-2026-19868 can let attackers holding credentials for a different login method get past SAML checks, including SAML-enforced MFA.
Link: https://www.securityweek.com/sonicwall-patches-exploited-sonicos-bug-that-weakens-vpn-logins/
 
🚨 Hackers Target OpenSSH SSHole Flaw Within Hours of Disclosure, Gain Root on Honeypot
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Qualys
Fonte: The Hacker News
CVSS: 8.1
Resumo:
Threat actors are attempting to exploit a recently disclosed security flaw impacting OpenSSH that can enable sign-ins to accounts that have no password set, according to Previdian. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-123158 (CVSS score: 8.1) and codenamed SSHole (or *sshole), impacts Linux systems that run OpenSSH on the musl C library with Pluggable Authentication Modules (PAM) disabled,
Link: https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/hackers-exploited-openssh-sshole-flaw.html
 
🚨 CVE-2026-63217 - Check Point
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Check Point
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 6.5
Resumo:
SuiteCRM is an open-source, enterprise-ready Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software application. Prior to 7.15.2 and 8.10.2, the generatePdf entry point loads an arbitrary record through BeanFactory::getBean() without checking the requesting user's record access. The affected flow begins at modules/AOS_PDF_Templates/generatePdf.php and uses generatePdf, and BeanFactory::getBean() to carry attacker-controlled...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-63217
 
💣 QNAP says hackers breaching NAS devices in Plex2Shell attacks
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: SentinelOne
Fonte: BleepingComputer
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
QNAP urges users to update Plex Media Server to the latest version available in the QNAP App Center, as hackers are exploiting the Plex2Shell vulnerability chain.
Link: https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/qnap-says-hackers-breaching-nas-devices-in-plex2shell-attacks/
 
💣 SonicWall warns of new SSL-VPN MFA bypass flaw exploited in attacks
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: SentinelOne
Fonte: BleepingComputer
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
SonicWall has released security updates to fix seven vulnerabilities in SonicOS firewalls, including an SSL-VPN authentication bypass flaw exploited in attacks.
Link: https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/sonicwall-warns-of-new-ssl-vpn-mfa-bypass-flaw-exploited-in-attacks/
 
💣 OpenAI's new GPT-6 Cyber AI finds 81 Firefox flaws, 948 Linux bugs
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: SentinelOne
Fonte: BleepingComputer
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
OpenAI has revealed GPT-6 Cyber, a new artificial intelligence model that has discovered 81 previously unknown high-severity Firefox vulnerabilities and developed working exploits for 948 distinct Linux kernel flaws.
Link: https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/openais-new-gpt-6-cyber-ai-finds-81-firefox-flaws-948-linux-bugs/

Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Ubuntu
Fonte: https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/rss.xml
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
Unfortunately that update was incomplete due to an incomplete fix for CVE-2026-103263, which broke static file serving for applications that subclass Tornado's StaticFileHandler, such as Jupyter, and could introduce a regression. Original advisory details: It was discovered that Tornado did not properly handle certain HTTP requests and network inputs. An attacker could possibly use these issues to cause a denial of s...
Link: https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8952-2

🚨 CVE-2026-119751 - WordPress
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: WordPress
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 5.3
Resumo:
Content Egg plugin for WordPress before 12.1.0 contains a broken access control vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to retrieve Content Egg product data from unpublished posts by calling the REST route POST /wp-json/content-egg/v1/render-blocks, whose permission_check() improperly returns true when no X-WP-Nonce header is supplied. Attackers can supply the post_id and module id of a draft, pending, sc...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-119751
 
🚨 CVE-2026-112337 - Azure
 
Criticidade: Baixa
Ferramenta: Azure
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 3.7
Resumo:
Wazuh from 3.7.0 before 4.14.9 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the Azure wodle get_graph_events() function that follows @odata.nextLink without host or HTTPS validation. Attackers who influence the nextLink value can redirect manager requests to attacker-controlled endpoints, capturing the reused Microsoft Graph bearer token and reaching internal services.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-112337
